message:
The Complete Wedding Planning Checklist, Month by Month

Every task from engagement to the honeymoon, grouped by when it actually needs to happen. Start 12+ months out with budget, guest count and venue. Book the vendors that sell out at 9–11 months. Lock in the details at 6–8 months, confirm everything at 2–4 months, and tie it together in the final month. A wedding to-do list that keeps anything important from slipping.
